# truenas_static_route (Resource)

Manages a static route on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_static_route" "vpn" {
  destination = "10.20.0.0/16"
  gateway     = "192.168.1.254"
  description = "VPN subnet via edge router"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Destination network in CIDR notation, e.g. "10.20.0.0/16".
- `gateway` (String) Gateway IP address for this route.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description for this static route.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric static route ID assigned by TrueNAS.
